title: SwappaTEE
tagline: A Fusion+ powered cross-chain swap between any EVM-supported chain and XRP Ledger
description:
SwappaTEE enables trustless token swaps between XRPL and Ethereum chains without intermediaries. It is powered by 1Inch's Fusion+ protocol and a TEE implementation of the escrow contracts on the XRPL side.

Instead of using centralized exchanges or risky bridge protocols, users get direct wallet-to-wallet swaps between XRPL and Ethereum. The TEE ensures escrow contracts execute correctly without requiring trust in any intermediary.

- Better liquidity access: XRPL's fast payments + Ethereum's deep DeFi markets in one workflow
- Reduced counterparty risk: No custody periods where funds could be lost or stolen
- Cost optimization: Route transactions through whichever chain is cheaper at the moment
- Payment apps that automatically find the best rates across both chains
- DeFi protocols that can tap liquidity from both ecosystems seamlessly  
- Traders who want cross-chain arbitrage without centralized exchange friction

The TEE approach is more secure than typical bridges (which have lost billions to hacks) while being more decentralized than custodial solutions. 1Inch's Fusion+ integration adds professional-grade order execution.
how_its_made:
- Both parties create escrows with same hash-lock on different chains
- Fund escrows
- One party reveals secret → both can claim tokens
- If timeout → automatic refunds

Infrastructure:
- Runs in Oasis Protocol ROFL (Intel TDX TEE)
- Uses 1inch Limit Order Protocol contracts
- Supports multi-transaction funding on XRPL
- Cloudflared tunnel for secure access
